newsitem.title: USA: NICE Systems sees Q3 shr $0.21-$0.23.
newsitem.headline: NICE Systems sees Q3 shr $0.21-$0.23.

text.p: NICE Systems Ltd said on Thursday it expected its third quarter 1996 revenues to be between about $10 million and $10.5 million and its earnings to be between about $0.21 and $0.23 per share.
The First Call mean estimate for the third quarter was $0.21 per share, against a loss of $0.03 per share in the third quarter last year.
The company delined to comment further on its results, which were due the first week in November.
It said it was releasing the preliminary estimates because of increased trading in the company's shares.
The stock was down 4-1/16 at 23-3/4, on volume of 1.8 million shares.
